Messages.Author: Valentine Michael Smith
Messages.Body:
The text of Maddness Network says that after any Methusela has completed 
the actions of his or her turn, any untapped Malkavian can take an action.

I need two clarifications, first, does this mean that if one Meth has 
played the Network all Malkavians in the game can take advantage of it?(I 
assume yes)
Second, does this mean that only one of my Malkavians can use it in any turn?
Or can I use all the untapped Malkavians I have after someone else has 
just finished their actions?

There exists some dispute about this in the circle I play with.
Thanks...
                                    -Dave@rain.org

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Valentine Michael Smith <dave@coyote.rain.org> wrote:
>I need two clarifications, first, does this mean that if one Meth has
>played the Network all Malkavians in the game can take advantage of it?...

Yes.

>Second, does this mean that only one of my Malkavians can use it in any turn?
>Or can I use all the untapped Malkavians I have after someone else has
>just finished their actions?

You can use all of your Malkavians in a single turn.
